annotations.title: The signed-in person's profile and settings

description: The profile of the person whose Supabase access token is sent (an agent API key is refused): id, email, name (shown with reviews), locale (language of our e-mails), country (market: the delivery country they compare for), watch_emails (false = every price-watch e-mail paused; security notices are always sent), how many price watches are active and paused, created_at, last_sign_in_at and `markets` to choose from. `deletion` says in words what delete_my_account removes, anonymises and keeps. Next: update_my_profile, sign_out, delete_my_account.
name: get_my_profile
title: The signed-in person's profile and settings
